title: GradeQuickRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/grade:quick (PRD 7.4, SDD 7). Producer of the endpoint: Grader (W3). Caller: Session Agent (W2), once for the retell and once for every scripted item, including an item the child did not answer (transcript ""). index is the 0-based position in the passage's items sorted by order, and 0 for the retell. A repeated call for the same session_id, turn_phase and index returns the stored result.
